description.value: OPA! of Greece is a Canadian Greek quick-service restaurant chain serving since 1998, with this Abbotsford location opening in February 2023. The menu centres on grilled souvlaki skewers, pita wraps, gyros, and platters with rice, roasted potatoes, and house-made tzatziki. Touring cyclists in Abbotsford will find a fast, filling protein stop with online ordering and a loyalty rewards app.
